title: Hot Smoked French Petit Pois Galette
description: A spicy and chewy French dish featuring petit pois, smoked to perfection, suitable for diabetics. This galette is a great meal prep option for a quick and easy lunch.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the almond flour, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the petit pois to the bowl and stir until they are evenly coated with the spice mixture.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt.
Add the egg mixture to the bowl with the petit pois and stir until everything is well combined.
Pour the mixture into a greased 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Bake the galette for 35 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Remove the galette from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
